name: Recommend 4D-STEM Calculator Parameters
description: Use the Nion Swift 4D-STEM recommendation calculator to load q_spec, calculate constraints, apply fixes, optimize defocus, and write results back to the UI. For SEM-started recommendation runs, call check_required_constraints with from_sem=true to read SEM UI values such as max_ht_kV, fov_A, and current_pA first, and do not ask the user for those values before trying the SEM UI/context path.
